meta.name: firecrawl-research
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user requests to research topics using FireCrawl, enrich notes with web sources, search and scrape information, or write scientific/academic papers. It extracts research topics from markdown files, creates research documents with scraped sources, generates BibTeX bibliographies from research results, and provides Pandoc/MyST templates for academic writing with citation management.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动搜索学术资料并生成参考文献
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要撰写学术论文并管理引用
copy.tagline_en: Automate academic research and generate citations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to write academic papers and manage references

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能根据markdown文件提取研究主题，调用FireCrawl搜索并抓取网页，生成带来源链接的文档，还能生成BibTeX参考文献并提供学术论文模板。
howto.when: 当用户要求用FireCrawl研究主题、从网页丰富笔记、或写学术论文时触发，例如说“Research this topic using FireCrawl”。

say.text: 研究这个主题：人工智能在医疗中的应用
say.note: FireCrawl自动搜索并抓取相关网页生成文档。

say.text: 从我的笔记文件提取主题并生成研究报告
say.note: 解析markdown中的标题和研究标签。

say.text: 根据研究成果生成BibTeX参考文献
say.note: 从抓取结果中生成标准引用条目。

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to extract research topics from markdown files, search and scrape web content via FireCrawl, generate markdown documents with source links, produce BibTeX bibliographies, and provide academic paper templates.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to research topics using FireCrawl, enrich notes with web sources, or write scientific papers, e.g., saying "Research this topic using FireCrawl".

say_en.text: Research this topic: AI in healthcare
say_en.note: FireCrawl searches and scrapes relevant web pages.

say_en.text: Extract topics from my notes and create a research report
say_en.note: Parses headers and research tags in the markdown file.

say_en.text: Generate BibTeX bibliography from my research results
say_en.note: Creates standard citation entries from scraped content.
